body:
⚙️ AdvancedCraft

AdvancedCraft is a modpack focused on technology, engineering, and automation, inspired by steampunk and industrial styles. Build giant machines, create automated systems, and transform simple resources into complex production lines using advanced engineering.

With mods like Immersive Engineering, the modpack offers an experience where technology is built piece by piece, using gears, cables, generators, and large industrial structures.

🔧 What you can do

- Build automated factories
- Generate power with industrial machines
- Create complex production lines
- Explore the world in search of new resources
- Develop increasingly advanced technology

⚙️ Modpack Style

AdvancedCraft’s focus isn’t just on modern technology, but on an industrial and mechanical style, where every machine looks like part of a massive factory powered by steam, gears, and electricity.

🌍 Experience

This modpack is ideal for those who enjoy:
- automation
- engineering
- building industrial bases
- technological progression

Get ready to transform the world into a massive steampunk factory.
